description: The rating a maimai DX chart gives for an achievement, the achievement a rating needs, and the rating of each rank (S to SSS+). Give a chart (looked up with its current internal level) or an internal level. Achievements are integers in 1/10000 of a percent: 100.7543% is 1007543.

achievement.description: Achievement in 1/10000 of a percent, an integer: 100.7543% is 1007543, 99.5% is 995000

combo.description: Combo lamp: fc, fcp (FC+), ap or app (AP+). AP and AP+ add 1 to the rating.

difficulty.description: Difficulty of the chart of song: basic … remaster

internal_level.description: Internal level (譜面定数) instead of a chart: 13.7

server.description: Game server (jp, intl, usa, cn), whose internal level is used where it differs. Default jp.

song.description: The chart: a sheet ID (dsht_…), or a song ID or name with type and difficulty. Or give internal_level.

target_rating.description: A rating of the chart to reach: the lowest achievement that gives it

type.description: Type of the chart of song: dx or std

name: calculate_rating

chart.description: The chart, when one was given

dataAsOf.description: When the catalog was last updated

result.description: The rating of achievement, when one was given

minAchievement.description: Lowest achievement that gives target_rating (without the AP bonus); null if none does

thresholds.description: The rating at the lowest achievement of each rank from S to SSS+

title: Calculate chart rating
